events.title: The Animation Update: Deep Rise Comes Alive
events.summary: Hello Dawnseekers, This is our biggest update yet. The headline: we have added a ton of animations. Combat, every gathering minigame, the map and the outpost all move, react and feel far more alive than before, and everything now uses the game's own stone and carved lettering instead of plain text. Here is what changed. Combat comes alive Victory, Your Turn and End Turn are now carved stone plaques with hand made lettering. events.title: Run Overhaul: Card Drafting Arrives, and We're in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hey Dawnseekers, Back in July we tore out combat and rebuilt it as a card battle system. It fixed the fight. It did not fix the run. Here is what kept happening in testing. Fight one was tense. Fight two was tense. By fight five you were playing the same fight again, with the same deck, making the same reads. Every battle worked on its own. events.title: Outpost Overhaul: Buildings, Dawnseekers & Research Reforged
events.summary: Hey Dawnseekers,Last week we showed you the combat overhaul. This week, the outpost got the same treatment.That's what the outpost looked like before. events.title: Combat Overhaul: Card Battles Have Arrived
events.summary: Hey Dawnseekers,We need to be honest with you about something.While playtesting Zone 1, we kept running into the same problem: you fight a LOT on your way up. And our old combat system, simple attack and defend exchanges, just couldn't carry that weight. It worked. But it wasn't fun by the tenth fight.
